title: Year of Dragons Digital Planner for GoodNotes with Growing Dragon Stickers
description: Hatch a dragon from your habits. Year of Dragons is a hyperlinked GoodNotes planner: four seasons, four elemental dragons, 12 monthly habit trackers and 32 watercolor stickers that grow from egg to adult as your streak gets longer. iPad planner, digital stickers, habit tracker, instant download.

title: How the Dragon Habit Tracker Works: Paste a Stage at Every Streak Milestone
description: Track 5 habits a day in GoodNotes. Hit a streak milestone, lasso the next dragon sticker and paste it over the faded stage. By day 30 your egg has grown into an adult dragon. A gamified habit tracker for iPad with watercolor dragon stickers, hyperlinked and ready to download.
alt_text: September habit tracker page with four dragon stages pasted into the growth bar

title: Four Seasons Four Dragons: Gamified GoodNotes Planner for the Whole Year
description: Autumn fire, winter ice, spring water, summer lightning. Each season has its own dragon and its own life area: habits, rest, self-care, study and savings. Collect all four adults in the Hall of Dragons. Digital planner for GoodNotes and Notability with 32 transparent PNG stickers.
alt_text: Four adult watercolor dragons: fire, ice, water and lightning, labelled by season

title: Fire Dragon Digital Stickers for GoodNotes: 8 Life Stages from Egg to Adult
description: Ember the fire dragon in 8 watercolor stages: egg, hatchling, baby, child, juvenile, adolescent, young adult and antlered adult. Transparent PNG stickers for GoodNotes, Notability and digital planners. Part of the Year of Dragons habit planner, autumn season.
alt_text: Eight fire dragon stickers arranged in two columns, from a blue egg with glowing cracks to an adult dragon in flames

title: Ice Dragon Digital Stickers for GoodNotes: 8 Watercolor Growth Stages
